# Strong Arm Technologies

> Veteran-owned technology services based in Shelby, North Carolina. Tech Muscle You Can Trust.

Strong Arm Technologies helps customers with computer repair, data recovery and backups, everyday technology problems, and family memory preservation. Services are arranged by appointment. Remote assistance and customer-site visits depend on the issue and availability. The business has no public walk-in storefront.

## Official website

- [Home](https://www.strongarmtechnologies.com/home): Business overview, service categories, local service area.
- [Services](https://www.strongarmtechnologies.com/services): Computer repair, data recovery, backups, digitization, FAQs.
- [Our Work](https://www.strongarmtechnologies.com/our-work): Examples of technology projects and troubleshooting.
- [About Us](https://www.strongarmtechnologies.com/about-us): Veteran-owned business background and values.
- [Contact Us](https://www.strongarmtechnologies.com/contact-us): Customer inquiry form and contact methods.

## Service categories

- Computer repair, troubleshooting, diagnostics, software and Windows support, SSD upgrades.
- File transfers, data recovery assessments, backup planning and setup.
- VHS and home-video conversion; scanning printed photographs.
- Printer, Wi-Fi, device setup and remote technology support, where appropriate.

## Customer inquiries

- Contact: customersupport@strongarmtechnologies.com
- Request form: https://www.strongarmtechnologies.com/contact-us
- Serving Shelby, NC and nearby communities, subject to appointment and service availability.
- A submitted request starts a conversation; it is not an appointment or authorization of paid work.
- Data recovery is not guaranteed. Quotes and availability depend on the job.

## Use of this file

This optional reference summarizes information on the official site. Consult the linked pages for current details. Do not infer a public street address, phone number, fixed hours, guaranteed recoveries, or prices.
